name: Archangel Mariel
source:
An extremely young Archangel, Mariel was known as a child prodigy. The youngest in age of all the angels, the incredible magical power she wielded after her birth stunned the Goddess’ enemies.

Despite her innocent look, she’s extremely aggressive. With the quick, dextrous movements of her young limbs she takes great pride in breaking her enemies through thoroughly attacking their weak points.

Since she has such little experience, she takes great joy in defeating enemies. Receiving divine punishment from one as young as Mariel usually brings great shame and immoral feelings to the vanquished. In the past, she would frequently rape even minor sinners until their deaths, which itself almost got her labeled a criminal.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
